summary.goal: Add plan-level context field to PlanVersion as a freeform Record<role, Record<string, unknown>> that captures formalized decisions by role
summary.context: We have 'understanding' (loose observations) and 'specification' (implementation details). Context bridges them - it captures formalized decisions that emerge from understanding and guide specification. The flow is: understanding (observations) -> context (decisions) -> specification (implementation).

model.structure: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> - any role key, any fields within. Schema is freeform; suggested roles/fields are documented for agent prompts but not enforced.
model.purpose: Crystallize exploratory observations into actionable decisions that guide step-level specs

summary.freeform_rationale: Different roles think differently, orgs have different needs. PlannerLead spawns specialist agents dynamically. The Orchestrator is an LLM that can understand any JSON structure. Intelligence lives in agent prompts, not Zod schemas.
in_scope: Zod schemas for RoleContext variants (DesignerContext, ArchitectContext, TesterContext, SecurityContext)
API endpoints for reading/updating context per role
MCP tools for agents to write context
UI tab in PlanEditorPage for viewing/editing context
out_of_scope: Automatic derivation of context from understanding (manual for now)

acceptance_criteria.description: PlanVersion schema includes optional 'context' field as z.record(z.string(), z.record(z.string(), z.unknown()))
Suggested roles documented: designer, architect, modeler, tester, security (not enforced in schema)
Suggested fields per role documented in design_spec (for agent prompts, not schema validation)
Database stores context at plan_versions level in JSONB column
GET /plans/:id/versions/:version returns context field
PATCH /plans/:id/versions/:version/context/:role updates role-specific context (any fields)
PlanEditorPage has Context tab (alongside Plan | Understanding)
Context tab shows role cards dynamically based on populated roles
'+' button allows adding new role tab with suggested roles or custom role name
Within each role tab, key-value editor allows adding/editing any fields
Context fields are editable inline on draft plans
MCP tools can read and write context per role (any fields)
Existing plans without context continue to work (backward compatible)

design_spec.schema_approach: Freeform: z.record(z.string(), z.record(z.string(), z.unknown())). The suggested roles and fields below are documentation for agent prompts - they are NOT enforced by Zod validation. Agents use these as guidelines; users can add any role or field.
